note: DT.5k (Kina / quokka-stack dead_symbol false positives): five TypeScript receiver shapes the graph could not type, each beside the look-alike that must stay unbound. An Angular signal query field (`form = viewChild(FilingForm)`, `viewChild<Toggle>('sw')`, `contentChild.required(Dropzone)`) holds the class a read `this.form()` returns, so `this.form()?.reset()` binds FilingForm::reset; a `{ read: ViewContainerRef }` option yields the read type, never the locator, also with two type arguments (`viewChild<Dropzone, ViewContainerRef>('zone', { read: .. })`); an untyped `viewChild('box')` types nothing (no method-name guess binds `this.box()?.clear()`), and a list query (`viewChildren(Chip)`) holds an array, so `this.chips().filter(..)` is not Chip::filter. An inline `inject(T)` (`inject(CountriesService).list()`, a guard's `const auth = inject(AuthService)`) is DI from the scope that runs it (INJECTS) and a receiver of type T; a project-local `inject` is neither; only the first argument is the token (`inject(AuthService, OPTIONAL)` passes OPTIONAL by value, a USES); and a third-party `inject(Router)` never binds the repo's own same-named `legacy/router::Router` (no repo-unique name stands in for an unbound import). A static member read `CountriesService.FALLBACK` USES the class, but not from the class's own members. A getter or setter read on another object (`auth.isLoggedOut` on an `inject(T)` local, `this.auth.isAuthenticated`, `this.auth.session = ..`) is a CALLS of the accessor (rules receiver_accessor_read / receiver_accessor_write); a method read as a value is not, and `router.url` on the third-party Router is not the legacy Router's getter. A local holding a bare call's result (`const store = makeStore()`) is of the callee's declared return type, same-file or imported; an unannotated factory, a parameter that shadows the factory's name, and a factory declared to return the third-party Router type nothing in the repo.
